title: Postdoctoral Fellowships Worldwide - The call is open to people from research institutes and universities from all over the world. job with IBSA Foundation for scientific research | 12866300
gist: Job listing: IBSA Foundation for scientific research offers seven 32,000 EUR fellowships worldwide for under-40 researchers in dermatology, endocrinology, fertility/urology, orthopaedics/pain and healthy ageing/regenerative medicine, plus a 5,000 EUR equity prize for developing-country labs; deadline January 31, 2027. Promotional content with minimal market signal.

insights.claim: IBSA Foundation for scientific research offers 7 fellowships of 32,000 EUR each in dermatology, endocrinology, fertility and urology, orthopaedics/rheumatology/pain medicine, and healthy ageing/regenerative medicine, with a deadline of January 31, 2027.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Indicates pharma-linked foundation funding priorities in specialty and ageing medicine.

insights.claim: IBSA Foundation will award an additional 5,000 EUR research equity prize to the best project carried out in a laboratory or institution based in a developing country.

insights.so_what: Small but explicit push to widen research access in resource-limited settings.

insights.claim: IBSA fellowship applicants of any nationality must be under 40, hold a degree in medicine, biology, pharmacy, biotechnology or bioengineering, and be hosted by a non-economic research organization; permanent positions such as professors are excluded.

insights.so_what: Targets early-career researchers in academic host institutions.
